## Description

Medvya's subscription invoices (MDV-P5-043) are paid online: India by UPI AutoPay or card mandate through the Razorpay adapter (MDV-P4-007), the UAE by card, Apple Pay or bank transfer through the UAE adapter (MDV-P4-008), on Medvya's own merchant accounts (MDV-P4-032), never a clinic's. A confirmed payment marks the invoice paid; a failed one starts the dunning ladder of MDV-P5-043. Until this ticket, Finance marks invoices paid by hand.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an owner with a due Medvya invoice in India, when they pay by UPI AutoPay or card, then the provider's confirmed payment marks the invoice paid once, even if the webhook arrives twice.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given an owner in the UAE, when they pay by card, then the payment is collected on Medvya's UAE merchant account in AED and the invoice is marked paid.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a payment fails, when the provider reports it, then the dunning ladder starts and clinicians can still read and treat.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a payment, when it is logged, then no card or bank detail is stored by Medvya, only the provider's reference.
